verdict.rationale: Whether source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software app, including an authenticator, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Microsoft Authenticator's source is published or openly licensed. The docs call it a "free app", which refers to price, not license. The only open-source mention is a community recommendation of a different app (Aegis), which does not transfer to this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
